question: What kinds of impurity in ritual materials are identified as needing removal?
premises: Contact with the untouchable is a possible impurity
Unjustly acquired items are another impurity
Both cases are presented as alternatives
inference: Impurity may arise from touching the untouchable or from using what was unjustly acquired.
plain_english: Whether there has been contact with the untouchable, or what has been unjustly acquired.
